title: 练习不是低质量的重复 #dating #pua #搭讪

timeline.summary: Mikey distinguishes practice from mere repetition and says repetition by itself cannot produce effective progress.
He says proper practice needs a good mentor, a goal and feedback, contrasting that structure with effort that looks diligent but produces no result.
For approach practice, he favors phased progress and targeted strategy adjustments over spending hours approaching only to accumulate repetitions.

claims.speaker: Mikey (visual/channel continuity)
claims.statement: Mechanical repetition is not sufficient practice; he says useful practice needs goals, feedback and targeted adjustment.
claims.conditions: A general teaching claim rather than verified evidence that a particular mentor or program works.

claims.speaker: Mikey (visual/channel continuity)
claims.statement: He recommends measuring approach practice by phased improvement and changing strategy in response to feedback rather than by hours or repetitions alone.
claims.conditions: The Short gives no operational milestones, feedback standard or evidence that quantity is never useful.
